about_the_game:
Transform Lisa into her legendary new form with a brand new costume! This allows you to change her costume from her traditional Knight gear into a lovely, pretty magical dress uniform for both in and out of battle. Additionally, it changes the "Arm Webs" and "Leg Webs" status images to silky smooth, but surprisingly strong ribbons!

Once downloaded, her costume can be changed at anytime in the "Options" menu under the DLC section by selecting the "Sexy Cure" costume.
